title: Co-Evolution: cross-vendor review benchmark for coding agents

glm-5.3-flash.note: Regular list price. A launch promotion (0.075 / 0.015 / 0.25) ran through 2026-09-09; the list rate is used so runs before and after it price the same.

statistics.paired_test: exact two-sided McNemar on discordant tasks
statistics.rank: Rank(UB): 1 + number of arms whose interval lower bound exceeds this upper bound

sampling.note: A uniform random draw, so the observed score is an unbiased estimate of the full-split score with a binomial interval.

difficulty_annotation.note: Human time-to-fix estimate shipped with SWE-bench Verified. A public field, not a gold patch or hidden test.

runs.label: base50-light
runs.note: Light tier (Sonnet implements, gpt-5.6-terra as the Codex seat). Arms A, B, E complete on all 50 tasks.

runs.label: base50-light-interim-378
runs.note: Provisional Phase 1 snapshot frozen at 378/450 terminal cells after Kimi was suspended for insufficient balance. Official evaluator reports cover all submitted patches in C, D, F, G, H, I, J, K and L; explicit no-patch outcomes count unresolved, while unfinished cells remain excluded. C and I are selected partial subsets, and B vs D has 49 shared pairs rather than the pre-registered 50. This run also exceeded the original 550-dispatch authorization on an observable lower bound of 576 Claude dispatches because retry caps applied per invocation rather than cumulatively.

runs.label: base50
runs.note: Frontier tier partial run (Fable, gpt-5.6-sol). Generated from a dirty harness worktree and stopped part way through A and B; kept as-is and shown with this flag, never as a headline.

preregistration.note: One primary contrast per phase, declared before the phase runs, so the headline needs no multiple-comparison correction. Everything else is exploratory. Outcomes are never written here: the site fills them from the evaluator reports.

analysis.primary_statistic: paired per-task comparison on the same frozen tasks: per-task mean over seeds, discordant table, exact two-sided McNemar
analysis.interval: Wilson 95% on the single-run rate; hierarchical bootstrap over repository, task and seed when seeds exist
analysis.secondary_correction: Holm across secondary pairwise contrasts within a phase

phases.name: Finish the light matrix on random50

primary_contrast.question: cross-vendor bounce vs self-bounce: does any second pass help, or only a cross-vendor one?

phases.exit: nine light-tier rows complete on the same 50 tasks; B-vs-D discordance table published

phases.name: Tier crossing on the same 50 tasks

primary_contrast.question: does a cheap implementer with a strong reviewer match a strong solo at lower cost per solved task? (A at frontier tier vs M)

phases.exit: cost-vs-pass-rate Pareto plot with light, frontier, mixed and max rows on the same 50 tasks

phases.name: Scale for power

primary_contrast.question: does the cross-vendor bounce beat the solo at confirmatory power?

phases.exit: confirmatory CI on the primary contrast at 300 tasks x 3 seeds

sampling.note: A uniform random draw, so the observed score is an unbiased estimate of the full-split score with a binomial interval.

difficulty.note: Human time-to-fix estimate shipped with SWE-bench Verified. A public field, not a gold patch or hidden test.
